extracted.name: Marinated Spicy Pork Chops
extracted.description: This tasty marinade comes together in minutes and can be used for pork, steak, or chicken. The meat can marinate in the refrigerator for up to 12 hours.
instruction_lines: Combine soy sauce, lemon juice, brown sugar, chili sauce, and garlic powder in a large resealable bag. Place pork chops into the bag and seal. Marinate for 6 to 12 hours in the refrigerator. Turn the bag over about halfway through.
Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat.
Lightly oil the grate. Arrange pork chops on the grate and cook 5 to 7 minutes on each side until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees F (63 degrees C).
